picks.title: The 9 buzziest startups from Y Combinator's latest Demo Day, according to VCs
picks.why_it_matters: YC Demo Day is the highest-signal dealflow event of the year—knowing which companies peers are excited about helps calibrate where competitive rounds will form and which sectors (nuclear, neurotech) are gaining momentum.

picks.title: AI's most powerful CEOs hit the brakes
picks.why_it_matters: A coordinated slowdown from frontier labs reshapes the AI startup landscape—creating openings for vertical AI applications and infra plays while signaling potential regulatory moats that could protect or constrain portfolio companies.

picks.title: Johnson calls for AI solutions but says Congress won't take the lead
picks.why_it_matters: Congressional inaction on AI regulation extends the window of regulatory uncertainty—founders building in healthcare, fintech, or defense AI need to price in state-level patchwork rules rather than federal clarity.
